beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the dragon's naming ceremony, where do we put the fire extinguishers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dragon eats anyone who brings one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Who handles the insurance exemption?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then collect enough to rebuild the hall before we let it in. You hold the money outside; I'll handle the naming.

reason: The original deposit fallback is coherent but general. A5 now turns unavailable insurance into a deadline, a stated amount basis and divided responsibility for the same ceremony.
comparison: The dragon alternative assigns money custody and naming duties before admission; the moon-audit alternative authorizes overtime and checks delivery cover.
scope: Local writer revision only; no technical retries or fresh-review correction counters changed.
